lines.zh: 一圈一圈地爬，身子拱起来
lines.en: Crawling a loop at a time, my body arching
I walk the veins, and I have many feet
I chew my way along the leaf's edge

lines.zh: 平原上的叶子够我吃很久
lines.en: There are leaves enough on the plains to last me
Every segment pushes me forward
I only walk on leaves
Drop me on soil and I am finished

lines.zh: 我啃了一个洞，正好穿过
lines.en: I chewed a hole big enough to pass through

lines.zh: 舍不得走太远，这里的叶子好
lines.en: I will not stray, the leaves here are good

lines.zh: 热带草原的日照很足，叶子上暖
lines.en: The savanna sun is strong, the leaf is warm
I crawl to the leaf's underside, it is cool

lines.zh: 我走得很慢，但一直在吃
lines.en: I move slowly, but I keep eating
I eat a stretch, then edge forward

lines.zh: 这片叶子我从边上吃到中间
lines.en: I work this leaf from the rim to the middle

lines.zh: 我把身下的叶子啃出一条路
lines.en: I chew a path through the leaf beneath me

lines.zh: 叶柄处汁水多，我慢慢爬过去
lines.en: More sap at the stalk, I head there slowly
I lie flat on the leaf, motionless

lines.zh: 绿色的身子，和叶子一个色
lines.en: A green body the same color as the leaf
I lift my front half and sway side to side
One step done, I rest
The leaf's pores are right beside me
My feet grip the leaf firmly

lines.zh: 我在叶脉交叉的地方停着
lines.en: I rest where the veins cross

lines.zh: 泥土的味道在下面，不是给我的
lines.en: The smell of soil is below, it is not for me

lines.zh: 我就这么趴着，一天也够
lines.en: I can lie like this for a whole day

lines.zh: 风吹过来，叶子和我一起晃
lines.en: The wind comes and the leaf sways with me

lines.zh: 叶子上被啃出的缺口越来越多
lines.en: The notches in the leaf are adding up
I grow slowly, in no hurry

lines.zh: 你从上面看我，我在叶子底下
lines.en: You look down at me, I am under the leaf

lines.zh: 我抬起头，把身子拱起来
lines.en: I raise my head and arch my body
I was eating, you blocked the light
Do not move me onto soil

lines.zh: 你手指比这片叶子还大
lines.en: Your finger is bigger than this leaf

lines.zh: 我身上有细毛，碰了会痒
lines.en: I have fine hairs, they itch if touched

lines.zh: 你看我爬得慢，我也不快
lines.en: You see I crawl slowly, and I will not speed up
This leaf is mine, do not pick it

lines.zh: 你伸手要抓，我先缩起来
lines.en: You reach to grab and I curl up first

lines.zh: 你这么高，我只认识叶子
lines.en: You are so tall, I only know leaves
I coil my body tighter

lines.zh: 我缩成一圈，汁水渗出来
lines.en: I curl into a ring and my juices seep out
A patch of my hairs is gone

lines.zh: 我掉在叶子上，滚了半圈
lines.en: I dropped onto the leaf and rolled half a turn
After that I did not move for a long while
I bite the stalk to steady myself
It hurts, but I still have to eat
I retreat to the leaf's underside
A soft body does not take squeezing
Let there not be a second

lines.zh: 叶子以外的东西，我不认
lines.en: Anything that isn't a leaf, I don't recognize
That is not a leaf

lines.zh: 那东西不像叶子，我不咬
lines.en: That thing isn't a leaf; I won't bite it
I rear up and sniff
It does not smell edible
I turn my head back to the leaf

lines.zh: 叶子就在嘴边，不用你给
lines.en: The leaf is at my mouth, I need nothing from you
A good leaf needs some moisture

lines.zh: 你把它放在叶子上，我再看看
lines.en: Put it on the leaf and I will look
I am not picky, I only eat leaves

lines.zh: 我被碰得从叶子上翻下去
lines.en: The bump rolled me off the leaf
I hooked the leaf edge with my feet

lines.zh: 你踩的是叶子，我在背面
lines.en: You stepped on the leaf, I am underneath
That raised all my hairs
I curl into a ring
The leaf shook hard, I held tight
I was squeezed to the leaf tip
Do not shake this leaf
I slipped a little and climbed back
One more touch and I drop off
I am small still, I must grow
I must eat first, then grow
There is only me on this leaf

lines.zh: 我这辈子就在这几片叶子间
lines.en: My whole life is among these few leaves

lines.zh: 等我结蛹的时候，什么都变了
lines.en: By the time I form a chrysalis, everything changes
I do not yet understand such things

lines.zh: 风把叶子吹开，我就看不见了
lines.en: When the wind parts the leaves I lose sight
Eating leaves matters more than anything

lines.zh: 我在叶子上留了一点丝
lines.en: I left a little silk on the leaf
Later, when I am grown
I wrap my feet around it
It is much heavier than a leaf
I gnawed at it, too hard
This does not taste like a leaf
I shove it with my head

lines.zh: 东西压在叶子上，我不敢过去
lines.en: It lies on the leaf, I dare not cross
I crawled a circle around it
It rolled to the edge and fell

lines.zh: 我只想找片干净的叶子
lines.en: I only want a clean leaf

lines.zh: 你别把它放在我的叶子上
lines.en: Do not put it on my leaf
A shadow fell on the leaf
I lift my head and look
I raise my front half high

lines.zh: 叶子上没有别的东西了
lines.en: There is nothing else on this leaf
I crawl to the underside
This leaf is too small to hide me
All my hairs are standing up
When you move, the leaf rustles

lines.zh: 我待着不动，装作一片叶子卷
lines.en: I stay still, pretending to be a curled leaf

lines.zh: 附近没有别的叶子可去
lines.en: There are no other leaves nearby

lines.zh: 叶子晃了一下，我停下来
lines.en: The leaf shook, I stopped

lines.zh: 我慢慢地往叶柄那边去
lines.en: I move slowly toward the leaf stalk
There is another leaf over there

lines.zh: 我听见咀嚼声以外的声音
lines.en: I hear sounds other than chewing
I press myself even flatter

lines.zh: 叶脉的岔口能挡住我一半
lines.en: The vein fork hides half of me
I stay put until you leave

lines.zh: 这片叶子上我啃出的洞，可以躲
lines.en: The hole I chewed can hide me

lines.zh: 我一动不动，连呼吸都慢
lines.en: I do not move at all, even my breathing slows
Under the leaf, no light gets in
I butt my head forward
That push landed on your hand
I bit once and it held
My hairs brushed you

lines.zh: 力气很小，可我能咬穿叶子
lines.en: Little force, though I can chew through a leaf
The skin on your hand is harder than a leaf
I shrink back and rear up again
Your hand will itch after that
I cannot even hold my footing doing this
Done, I return to the leaf
A small green dot has appeared on the leaf
I hatched on the underside of a leaf
The leaves on the plains are just new

lines.zh: 我先把身边的叶缘啃了一圈
lines.en: I chewed a ring around the nearest edge

lines.zh: 一片叶子下面，我挂在那儿
lines.en: I hang beneath a leaf
I worked my way out of the shell

lines.zh: 这叶子上没有任何别的虫
lines.en: There are no other insects on this leaf
I take my first bite
A gust comes and I grip the vein

lines.zh: 草原的光照在叶子上，很暖
lines.en: The savanna light falls warm on the leaf

lines.zh: 叶子先焦了，我也跟着卷
lines.en: The leaf scorched first, and I curled with it
I fell from the leaf onto the soil
The water has left me limp

lines.zh: 气浪把我从叶子上掀飞
lines.en: The blast flung me off the leaf

lines.zh: 一支箭把叶子钉在地上，我在旁边
lines.en: An arrow pinned the leaf to the ground, and I was beside it

lines.zh: 一股凉意从毛里钻进来
lines.en: A chill worked in through my hairs

lines.zh: 叶子被吃光了，我饿得发软
lines.en: The leaves are gone and hunger makes me limp

lines.zh: 雷光一亮，我整只都僵了
lines.en: A flash of lightning and I went stiff

lines.zh: 这里没有叶子，我只能掉下去
lines.en: No leaf here, I can only fall
